content_data.project_title: Integrated Patient Support Hub for Chronic Disease Management
content_data.project_description: Strategic initiative to develop a comprehensive patient engagement platform that enhances medication adherence and care coordination for chronic disease patients across our regional markets. This pilot will integrate digital tools, pharmacist consultations, and personalized care pathways to improve patient outcomes and strengthen customer relationships.
content_data.timeline: 18 months with Phase 1 (months 1-6) for platform development and pilot design, Phase 2 (months 7-12) for regional rollout, and Phase 3 (months 13-18) for evaluation and optimization
content_data.project_lead: Priya Sundaram, VP of Customer Experience and Digital Innovation
objectives: Generate actionable insights on patient behavior and treatment patterns
deliverables: Pilot program results and ROI analysis with expansion recommendations
Personalized patient education content library for key therapeutic areas
Data analytics dashboard for tracking adherence and health outcomes
content_data.risk_assessment: Moderate risk profile with primary concerns around patient adoption rates, data privacy compliance across multiple jurisdictions, and integration complexity with existing pharmacy systems. Mitigation strategies include phased rollout approach, dedicated regulatory oversight, and comprehensive change management support for pharmacy partners.
